notes: Asset inventories include observed network resources as well as current DOM assets; counts must not be interpreted as unique visible branding elements.
Game thumbnails, trailers, game-specific sprites and third-party product logos are content assets rather than UGames identity replacements.
Currency artwork should retain a clear association with the actual payment provider and unit; changing its name would require a separate product decision.
No implementation changes were made during this audit.
